content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone tell me how to change the IP address in [product_name] [version_no]?
The simplest way is to use the device interface: Main Menu > Network > IP address, then confirm with OK.

Another option is through [product_name] software: Tool > Ethernet. Here, you can configure the IP address as well. If you download the program and the configured IP in the settings differs from the current device IP, you'll be prompted to change it. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed easy ways to change the IP address on [product_name], highlighting both direct configuration through the device menu and using related software tools. These methods are user-friendly and seem to suit user needs without unnecessary complexity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and intuitive process for updating the IP address on the device, ideally via a straightforward interface or software.
